predictions.selection_reason: strict mode option -> algorithm validation in toString -> filters output based on spec compliance
predictions.source_summary: this.algorithm comes from parsed SRI metadata, either from user-provided strings via parse() or generated internally via fromData/fromStream
predictions.sink_summary: Return value flows to Integrity.toString() and serialize() functions, used in integrity verification (checkData/checkStream) and external API output
predictions.guard_summary: Strict mode validation: algorithm must be in SPEC_ALGORITHMS ['sha256','sha384','sha512'], digest must match BASE64_REGEX, options must match VCHAR_REGEX. If validation fails, returns empty string instead of SRI format
predictions.risk_pattern: Strict mode validation in toString() method filters output based on spec compliance - non-compliant algorithms result in empty string output, potentially breaking integrity verification flows
predictions.context_summary: Subresource Integrity (SRI) validation library - validates hash algorithms and formats against W3C spec. The changed line enforces strict algorithm validation when serializing SRI metadata
unresolved_facts: External usage patterns and whether strict mode is commonly enabled
Impact of empty string return on downstream integrity verification flows
Presence and behavior of getPrioritizedHash function referenced in checkData

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: algorithm whitelist validation causing denial of service when non-compliant algorithms are rejected with empty string return
